description: NES, MSX, Game Boy and PC Engine music player plugin (NSF, KSS, GBS, HES, AY) for Winamp and KbMedia Player
notes: This plugin is no longer developed.
To use the Winamp plugin, copy $dir\in_nez.dll into Winamp's Plugins folder (kb_nez.kpi is the KbMedia Player plugin).
nezplay.exe is a small standalone sample player: drag and drop a music file onto its window.
